A new mcp-tooling mode, Code Mode/UTCP mirror, doctor-owned installer or system-spec-kit retrieval hook costs more than the demonstrated need because each adds routing, setup or lifecycle upkeep that the existing optional pointer avoids.

Sweet Search is opt-in through global npm install, per-repository init and an explicit first index. Its package requires Node >=22.2.0, native builds target macOS/Linux with Windows via WSL2, old index formats require a full rebuild, and per-repository uninstall is available.

The package declares Apache-2.0 and ships third-party license notices; its CLA is for upstream contributors, not adopters. Current GitHub release listing has no entries, and this pass could not verify the latest npm version or commit timestamp, so maintenance cadence remains UNKNOWN.
